notes.title: "The Book of Warriors 2: Reborn" will launch its demo on May 14!
notes.notes:
Hello players, I'm Gtc, the producer of the strategy game series "The Book of Warriors " The core framework of the second game in the series, The Book of Warriors 2: Reborn, is now complete. As a small team, to quickly test out our imaginative ideas, we will release a demo version on STEAM on May 14th for a seven-day trial period.

We understand that the demo version still has many shortcomings due to the short development cycle, but we are eager to hear players' feedback on this new game. Therefore, the demo trial period will last for seven days: from May 14th to May 21st. After that, we will close the demo and continue to refine the game based on your feedback.
